Good morning cargo crew,
Rest breaks, before departure: a short note from our desk

Please review the animal load sheets before pushback and keep the companion areas quiet and steady. Handlers should use calm, humane methods at every stage, and the welfare coordinator must be included whenever an animal shows signs of stress or needs a comfort check. If you are handling a pet crate for a small dog, <<FACT F074>>. Keep the note in mind when you speak with travelers and confirm that the cabin and hold arrangements match the booking record.

For reptile cases, follow the desk guidance exactly and do not make exceptions at the gate. If a traveler asks about the paperwork, <<FACT F060>>. Also, confirm the health document before acceptance, because <<FACT F084>>. When an issue comes up, pause the process, keep the animal in a stable place, and update the operations board so the next team can continue without delay.

Please also remember that carrier placement should allow for air flow, minimal movement, and a quiet path through the work area. If Hugo Muller or Hugo Johnson is listed on the manifest, check the special notes before handoff, and keep Maisie's case with the other comfort items if present. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will remain available for coordination, and crews should send any concern as soon as it appears so we can support a safe and orderly departure.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
